meta.author: claude
meta.description: Market stall, level 1 of 3: shell and fittings (what soldiers build first). Over budget: 83 blocks vs 17 (and 3 x 3 instead of 3 x 2, so the trader has a spot behind the counter). Spruce-post stall with a plank counter under a thin, sloped awning of red and white carpet stripes on trapdoor boards; trader enters from the side; L1 has barrels, a crate, grain and a trade sign; L2 adds the striped wool front edge, lanterns, produce, grain and a shelf; L3 the sign post, banner, stool, back barrel, scraps bin and flowers. Decoration step adds: potted_plant, sign_text.
meta.changes: Quality check round 2: level 1 is less bare: a flower pot (tulip by the decoration step) and a bale of grain on the front barrels at the counter edge; level 2 puts a pumpkin out at the front edge and a melon beside the stall. (Round 1: one-block-thick sloped red and white awning instead of solid blue wool, goods at the front, goods on level 1.)
